title: RND-02 registration My Wallet and Chrome 31

Combination: My Wallet from 29.12.2013 and Windows/Chrome 31.0.1650.63. Analysis of browser source and execution JS-The old browser didn't run completely GPU Nope.

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

audit.py Checks the matching of inputs and results, then uses cache. New inputs require a new folder. report.py table AUDIT No computation registration.cjs manually in the accepted folder: it overwrites TRACES.

All 10 scripts and stubs are visible in registration.cjs; No network requests are sent UUID and entropy It's synthetic. It does the unaltered signup IIFE; DOM, AJAX-Answers, saving and encryption after the first key are replaced by adapters.

Artifacts: SOURCES/URLS and sources; SOURCE_AUDIT decoded Gitiles-file Git blob checks; INPUT_PINS and inputs copies RND-01; NODE_RUN/TRACES - Raw calls; AUDIT/ACCEPTANCE/COMPLETE - results and integrity RND-01/SX They don't change.

Existing ones are used Python 3.11/coincurve and Node 24.18.0. No addictions were established AUDIT It's about control, not about search speed RESULTS, PROTOCOL and artifacts; chat history is not required.
